identity.deliverable: Reconcile binary, driver, fixture and reference identities; preserve every gate.
identity.completion: Every report is admitted or explicitly rejected with a reason; every unresolved row is mapped.

boundaries.deliverable: Native storage, configuration, process and provider assertions.
boundaries.completion: Named frozen assertions pass against both implementations; durable state and exact role/session history agree.

github.deliverable: Native transport, permission, dependency and feedback assertions.
github.completion: Named assertions pass with live command-boundary checks, including revoked permissions and visibility changes.

workflow.deliverable: Native controller, assignment, recovery and restack assertions.
workflow.completion: Named assertions pass through native workflows; saved turns, exact sessions and human board edits are preserved.

audits.deliverable: Native failure fixtures and explicit source/constant audits.
audits.completion: Each required guard is exercised natively; each exact pinned source span has a reviewed audit with no unasserted behaviors.

integration.deliverable: Full inventory, evidence and independent-review handoff.
integration.completion: All original gates pass at the same pushed head; independent review remains required.
